sloka: स्वस्ति देवि तरामि त्वाम् पार्येन्मे पतिर्वतम् ।यक्ष्ये त्वाम् गोनहस्रेण सुराघटशतेन च ॥२-५५-२०॥
transliteration: svasti devi tarāmi tvām pāryenme patirvatam ।yakṣye tvām gonahasreṇa surāghaṭaśatena ca ॥2-55-20॥

translations.english: On reaching the middle of the river Yamuna, Sita made reverential salutations to her saying O goddess, I am crossing you, may safety be ours and may my husband fulfil his vow After Rama's (safe) return to the city (of Ayodhya) ruled by the Ikshvaku kings, I shall worship you with a thousand cows and a hundred pots of wine.
